description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25002753
DOCKET NO. F02265017
PLAINTIFF – CITIBANK, N.A.
DEFENDANTS- DARRYL HICKS, KEB HANA, BANK USA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, BANK OF AMERICA, NA
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 1st DAY OF July 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of PLAINFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: BLOCK 502 LOT 34
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
420-24 SPRUCE STREET PLAINFIELD, NJ 07060
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: DIMENSIONS OF LOT: 66.67 x 150.23 1
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Essex Street (formerly as Division street)
SUPERIOR INTERESTS (if any): Any and all easements, covenants, restrictions and reservations of record; Any set of facts which an accurate survey and inspection would disclose; All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments and liens; Any unpaid assessment and any outstanding tax sale certificate; Rights of any party in possession frights protected by the NJ Anti-Eviction Act; All Local, County, State and Federal ordinances and regulations; Any condominium association lien granted priority by N.J.S.A 46:8B-21b; Any outstanding Condominium, PUD or Homeowner Association dues or fees; Rights of the United States of America, if any; The property is sold in its "AS IS" condition; Purchaser shall be responsible for Sheriffs costs, commission, deed recording fees and realty transfer fees.
Plainfield City Solid Waste and Sewer Utility holds a claim for taxes due and/or other municipal utilities such as water and/or sewer in the amount of $300.35 plus penalty and $1,802.10 plus penalty owed in arrears for trash. as of 06/02/2026
Plainfield City Solid Waste and Sewer Utility (SEWER) holds a claim for taxes due and/or other municipal utilities such as water and/or sewer in the amount of $113.30 open plus penalty; $444.44 open plus penalty, owed in arrears as of 06/02/2026.
Property Registration Fee Exists - contact HERA Property Registry at 321-234-5303 for details holds an interest in the property held by Property Registration Fee Exists - contact HERA Property Registry at 321-234-5303 for details.
Plaintiffs upset bid is $327,000.00 in accordance with the requirements of Section 12 of P.L. 1995, c. 244 (C.2A:50-64) as amended.
The property is reported to be owner occupied.
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Union County in Mortgage Book M11536 Page 386 Instrument Number 389413 .
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $415,243.93 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: June 4, 2026

308 HARPER DRIVE

Moorestown, NJ 08057
